searchText: Hi! We're building a new execution client but we want to only support post-merge forks. Unfortunately, some hive tests seems to have pre-merge configurations, for example this one: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/blob/master/simulators/devp2p/init/genesis.json . Would it make sense for to update these to use a post merge configuration? generally makes sense, yeah First EEST release for Devnet-3: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/pectra-devnet-3%40v1.0.0 Contains updated spec and coverage for 7702. This is the first release using EthJS transition tool (many thanks to <@508125616940515329> !)
